en.headline: Immigration Department prepares for first inbound peak at new Huanggang Port
en.dek: Officials expect heavy return traffic this afternoon and evening on the final day of the Chung Yeung holiday and are urging early registration for co-location clearance.

zh.headline: 入境處料新皇崗口岸下午至晚上迎首個入境高峰 籲預先登記合作查驗
zh.dek: 重陽節長周末最後一日，入境處預計下午至傍晚回港人流增多，會靈活調配人手，並呼籲合資格市民預先登記合作查驗e道。

en.headline: The Mills hosts free Curious Creatures Showcase with rare species until 1 November
en.dek: The Tsuen Wan venue has transformed Mill 6 into an ecological Halloween display featuring the African pygmy mouse and emperor scorpion among other unusual animals.

zh.headline: 南豐紗廠免費「萬聖節怪奇動物展覽」展至11月1日 多種珍稀生物首次亮相
zh.dek: 荃灣南豐紗廠六廠地下化身奇蟲樂園，展出非洲侎儒鼠、帝王蠍等罕見物種，入場免費。

en.headline: Immigration records over 1.32 million crossings on Chung Yeung Sunday
en.dek: Huanggang Port handled its highest daily total since reopening, with more than 152,000 trips, as overall traffic across all control points exceeded 1.32 million.

zh.headline: 重陽節全日逾132萬人次出入境 新皇崗口岸15.2萬創開通新高
zh.dek: 入境處指星期日各口岸合共錄得超過132.2萬人次，其中皇崗口岸約15.2萬人次為啟用以來最多。

en.headline: Female staff member burned in Hong Kong Cultural Centre stage fire
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished a blaze behind the Grand Theatre stage around 11:38am after a female employee in her 20s suffered burns to her face and arms.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀文化中心主劇場後台火警 女職員面手燒傷送院
zh.dek: 消防員約15分鐘將火救熄，一名二十多歲女職員面部及手臂燒傷，清醒送伊利沙伯醫院治理。

en.headline: Police receive 130 reports of suspected iPhone Duo credit card misuse, involving HK$5…
en.dek: As of 9am on Monday, the number of people reporting unauthorised charges for online smartphone purchases has risen, with cases handed to the cybercrime unit.

zh.headline: 警接130人報稱信用卡被盜用買iPhone Duo 涉款約500萬元
zh.dek: 警方周一表示截至上午九時，共接獲130宗懷疑信用卡被盜用於網上購買智能電話的報案，涉及金額約500萬元，案件交由網絡安全及科技罪案調查科跟進。

en.headline: John Lee meets AIIB President Zou Jiayi ahead of APEC finance meeting
en.dek: The Chief Executive welcomed the bank chief to Hong Kong and discussed stronger regional financial co-operation and support for an AIIB office in the city.

zh.headline: 李家超禮賓府會晤亞投行行長鄒加怡 歡迎出席APEC財長會議
zh.dek: 行政長官歡迎鄒加怡率團來港，雙方就加強區域金融合作交流，並全力支持亞投行在港設立辦事處。

en.headline: Man robs Yau Ma Tei convenience store with brick, flees with cash
en.dek: Police are hunting a man in his 50s who threatened a female staff member at a Jordan Road shop around 4am on Monday and took several thousand dollars.

zh.headline: 油麻地便利店遭男子持磚行劫 奪數千元現金逃去
zh.dek: 一名五十多歲男子周一凌晨約四時半闖入佐敦道便利店，以磚頭威脅女職員從收銀機取走數千元現金後逃逸，警方正追緝。

en.headline: Hong Kong stock market closed today for Chung Yeung Festival holiday
en.dek: Trading on the Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing is suspended for the full day as the general holiday falls on the Monday after the festival.

zh.headline: 港股今日重陽節假期休市一天
zh.dek: 重陽節逢周日，翌日周一為公眾假期，港交所全日暫停交易，預計周二恢復。

en.headline: Lee Tung Avenue lantern display ends today after more than six weeks
en.dek: More than 800 traditional red and custom palace lanterns have hung over the 200-metre pedestrian street in Wan Chai since early September.

zh.headline: 灣仔利東街中秋燈籠展今日最後一天 逾800盞紅燈籠及宮燈懸掛
zh.dek: 利東街200米林蔭大道自九月初起懸掛逾800盞傳統紅燈籠及全新宮廷燈籠，今日為展示最後一日。

en.headline: Police arrest man after finding suspected cocaine in Hung Hom car
en.dek: Officers stopped a private car on Tai Wan Road around 1am on Monday and arrested the driver in his 20s on suspicion of drug trafficking.

zh.headline: 紅碣大環道私家車檢獲懷疑可卡因 男司機涉販毒被捕
zh.dek: 警方周一凌晨約一時在紅碣大環道截查一輛私家車，發現約二十包懷疑可卡因，一名二十多歲男司機涉嫌販毒被捕。

en.headline: Observatory issues Yellow Fire Danger Warning as risk stays high
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the yellow signal at 6am on Monday, urging the public to take precautions against fires and hikers to remain vigilant.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色火災危險警告 火災風險偏高
zh.dek: 天文台周一早上六時發出黃色火災危險警告，指火災危險性頗高，呼籲市民採取防火措施，行山人士亦需提高警覺。

en.headline: EMSD finds missing lift door components in 74 more Taizoom buildings, total reaches 152
en.dek: The department said 150 private buildings and two public estates are affected, with about 180 more still to be checked, and ordered all contractors to review a decade of similar works.

zh.headline: 機電署公布再多74幢臺日升降機樓宇欠門框組件 總數增至152幢
zh.dek: 署方指受影響樓宇中150幢為私人住宅或商廈、兩幢為租者置其屋計劃屋邨，尚有約180幢未檢查，並已要求所有承辦商檢視過去十年同類工程。

en.headline: Local artist LeonLollipop’s Gloomie Museum exhibition runs at Harbour City until 25…
en.dek: The first solo show of the cheek-resting cat character features the 100th portrait, reimagined classical works with Hong Kong scenery, and terracotta-style cat sculptures.

zh.headline: 本地藝術家LeonLollipop「Gloomie Museum托腭貓藝術館」海港城展至10月25日
zh.dek: 首個個人展覽展出系列第100幅作品《Gloomie Lisa》，以香港地景重新演繹經典名畫，並設有兵馬俑造型貓士兵雕塑。

en.headline: Police arrest Porsche driver in Tsim Sha Tsui after finding cannabis in car
en.dek: Officers stopped the vehicle on Bristol Avenue on Sunday night, found a small amount of suspected cannabis and arrested the man on suspicion of drug driving.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀保時捷車內檢獲懷疑大麻 男司機涉藥駕被捕
zh.dek: 警方周日晚上約10時在碧仙桃道截查車輛，發現少量懷疑大麻，司機未能通過口腔液測試，涉嫌毒後駕駛被捕。

en.headline: PPA Asia 1500 Hang Seng Bank Hong Kong Slam begins at Kai Tak Arena
en.dek: The season-ending professional pickleball tournament runs until 25 October with a prize purse of US$1.1 million and players from more than 20 countries.

zh.headline: PPA亞洲1500恒生銀行香港大滿貫今起啟德體藝館開打
zh.dek: 賽事為PPA亞洲巡迴賽年度壓軸，至10月25日舉行，總獎金110萬美元，吸引逾20個國家及地區球手參與。

en.headline: The Mills hosts free exhibition of rare creatures for Halloween
en.dek: Visitors can see the African pygmy mouse, glowing emperor scorpion and other unusual animals at the Tsuen Wan venue until 1 November.

zh.headline: 南豐紗廠萬聖節怪奇動物展覽免費開放至11月1日
zh.dek: 荃灣南豐紗廠與香港昆蟲教育及科普中心合作，展出非洲侏儒鼠、紫外光下會發光的帝王蠍等罕見生物，每日中午至晚上7時開放。

en.headline: Liu and Chong attend Asian Para Games opening to support Hong Kong athletes
en.dek: The undersecretary for culture, sports and tourism and the new commissioner for sports met the Hong Kong, China delegation in Nagoya and will watch events in the coming days.

zh.headline: 劉震及莊敏婷出席亞殘運開幕式為港隊打氣
zh.dek: 文化體育及旅遊局副局長劉震和新任體育專員莊敏婷到名古屋與中國香港代表團見面，了解住宿及備戰情況，未來數日將到場館觀賽。

en.headline: Tourism Board to review Peak light trail after residents raise concerns
en.dek: The board said it would conduct broader consultation to refine arrangements for the planned installations along Lugard and Harlech Roads, aiming for a better balance with environmental protection and local needs.

zh.headline: 旅發局就山頂燈影項目進行更廣泛諮詢 檢視安排
zh.dek: 局方表示明白並重視居民意見，會繼續緊密溝通，檢視盧吉道及夏力道一帶燈影效果項目的整體安排，務求在旅遊發展、環境保護及居民需要之間取得更適切平衡。

en.headline: Customs seize cocaine and cannabis worth HK$6.8 million at airport, arrest two
en.dek: Officers found about 5.4 kilograms of suspected cocaine and 17 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds in the luggage of two mainland passengers arriving on consecutive days.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲約680萬元可卡因及大麻花 拘兩名內地旅客
zh.dek: 關員在連續兩日抵港的兩名內地旅客行李內，分別發現約5.4公斤懷疑可卡因及約17公斤懷疑大麻花。

en.headline: Long Win bus hits railing at Airport Skycity terminus, no one injured
en.dek: Police said the bus appeared to have lost control at a turning point around 2.49pm on Sunday, damaging about 10 metres of railing and the front of the vehicle.

zh.headline: 龍運巴士航天城總站疑失控撞毀欄杆 車頭嚴重損毀無人受傷
zh.dek: 警方指今午約2時49分接報，巴士在總站轉彎位撞毀約10米鐵欄，車頭泵把脫落，事件中無人受傷。

en.headline: Police arrest Pakistani couple over HK$22 million drug depot in Yuen Long village house
en.dek: Officers seized about 10 kilograms of ketamine, 30 kilograms of cocaine and a small amount of methamphetamine after intercepting a man leaving the premises on a motorcycle.

zh.headline: 警方元朗村屋破毒倉 拘巴基斯坦裔夫婦檢逾2200萬元毒品
zh.dek: 人員截查一名騎電單車離開的男子後，在村屋內檢獲約10公斤氯胺酮、約30公斤可卡因及少量冰毒。

en.headline: Police arrest Filipino domestic helper over alleged slapping of five-month-old baby in…
en.dek: The father reported the case at Queen Elizabeth Hospital after reviewing home CCTV that showed the helper striking the infant three times in the early hours.

zh.headline: 何文田菲傭涉掌摑5個月大女嬰被捕 父親翻查閉路電視揭發
zh.dek: 父親今早在伊利沙伯醫院報案，指閉路電視顯示外傭凌晨兩至四時三次掌摑女嬰。

en.headline: Centre for Health Protection investigates death of nine-year-old boy from invasive…
en.dek: The previously healthy boy developed fever and cough from 10 October, was transferred to intensive care on the 14th and died the following day at Tuen Mun Hospital.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查九歲男童染侵入性肺炎球菌病死亡個案
zh.dek: 男童10月10日起發燒咳嗽，14日轉送屯門醫院兒童深切治療部，翌日不治。

en.headline: Police investigate five dogs found dead near San Tin fishponds as possible animal cruelty
en.dek: Officers were called around 11.35am on Sunday after animal volunteers reported four black dogs dumped beside a rubbish heap, with a fifth carcass found nearby.

zh.headline: 新田魚塘旁發現五隻唐狗屍體 警方列作殘酷對待動物調查
zh.dek: 今早約11時35分動物義工報案，四隻黑狗棄於垃圾堆，附近再發現第五隻。

en.headline: Two people in their 70s die after charcoal burning at Tuen Mun estate
en.dek: Police said a man and woman found unconscious around 2.30pm on Sunday at Shan King Estate were later confirmed dead at Tuen Mun Hospital.

zh.headline: 屯門山景邨一對約70歲男女燒炭後證實死亡
zh.dek: 警方指今午約2時30分在景榮樓發現兩人昏迷，身旁有燒過的炭，送屯門醫院後不治。

en.headline: FEHD reminds public to check restaurant permits before taking dogs out for Halloween meals
en.dek: The department said more than 990 restaurants currently hold permission for dogs, and both operators and owners must follow leash and other rules.

zh.headline: 食環署提醒市民萬聖節外出用膳前確認食肆是否准許狗隻進入
zh.dek: 署方指目前逾990間食肆獲准容許狗隻，經營者及主人須遵守牽繩等規定。

en.headline: Former NPC deputy and educator Ng Hon-mun dies aged 100
en.dek: The Pui Kiu Education Institution said its honorary chairman passed away peacefully on Sunday morning in the company of family.

zh.headline: 前港區人大代表兼教育家吳康民逝世 享年100歲
zh.dek: 培僑教育機構表示，榮譽主席吳康民今早在家人陪伴下安詳辭世。

en.headline: Tang says talks to link private mall cameras to police SmartView network in final stage
en.dek: The security chief told a television programme that live monitoring would be risk-based and focused on crime hotspots, as the force aims for 60,000 cameras by 2028.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強：私人商場閉路電視接駁「銳眼」系統進入最後商討階段
zh.dek: 保安局局長在電視節目表示，實時接駁將視情況而定，優先犯罪黑點，目標2028年前安裝6萬支鏡頭。

en.headline: Two people in their 70s found unconscious after charcoal burning at Tuen Mun estate
en.dek: Police said a man and a woman were taken to Tuen Mun Hospital after being discovered unresponsive in a flat at Shan King Estate around 2.30pm on Sunday.

zh.headline: 屯門山景邨一對約70歲男女燒炭昏迷 送院搶救
zh.dek: 警方指今午約2時30分接報，景榮樓單位內一男一女昏迷，身旁有燒過的炭，已送屯門醫院。

en.headline: Firefighters extinguish smoke at Aberdeen Centre supermarket kitchen, no injuries
en.dek: The Fire Services Department said the blaze at the ParknShop on Nam Ning Street had been put out by the time crews arrived around 11am on Sunday.

zh.headline: 香港仔中心超市廚房冒濃煙 消防到場火已熄無人受傷
zh.dek: 消防處指南寧街13至23號百佳超級市場今早約11時接報，到場時火勢已熄，只剩殘煙，無人受傷亦毋須疏散。

en.headline: Chan says Hong Kong remains optimistic on growth after IMF upgrades forecast to 3.8 per…
en.dek: The Financial Secretary, writing after the IMF and World Bank meetings in Bangkok, noted the city’s unique position amid AI disruption and global energy price pressures.

zh.headline: 陳茂波指香港對增長仍樂觀 IMF上調預測至3.8%仍保持政府區間
zh.dek: 財政司司長出席曼谷IMF年會後在博客指，全球受AI擾亂及中東衝突能源價格壓力影響，香港具獨特橋梁優勢。

en.headline: Lam says Hong Kong will form task force to speed Greater Bay Area rule alignment
en.dek: The Secretary for Justice told a dispute resolution summit that the group is expected to start work with the mainland early next year.

zh.headline: 林定國指將成立專組加快粵港澳大灣區規則衡接
zh.dek: 律政司司長在大灣區爭議解決峰會表示，專組預計今年底或明年初成立，明年初與內地展開工作。

en.headline: St Stephen’s Society opens multimedia exhibition on Jackie Pullinger’s 60 years in Hong…
en.dek: The show at Central Market runs until 21 October and uses found objects to recreate scenes from Kowloon Walled City and other neighbourhoods.

zh.headline: 聖士提芬會中環街市開《285個家》展 回望潘靈卓在港60年
zh.dek: 多媒體藝術展至10月21日於中環街市一樓舉行，以旧鐵皮、電線等香港拾得物重現九龍城寨及幸福營生活場景。

en.headline: Observatory forecasts mainly fine and dry weather for the work week after Chung Yeung
en.dek: With Monday a public holiday, the coming work stretch from Tuesday is expected to be mainly fine and dry, turning very hot midweek under an anticyclone aloft.

zh.headline: 天文台料重陽假期後下周工作天大致天晴乾燥 星期三或醒熱
zh.dek: 星期一為公眾假期，天文台預測星期二起工作周大致天晴乾燥，星期三受高空反氣旋影響日間醒熱。

en.headline: LeonLollipop’s first solo show Gloomie Museum runs at Harbour City until 25 October
en.dek: The exhibition features the artist’s 100th Gloomie portrait, a feline Mona Lisa, plus sculptures of cat soldiers inspired by the Terracotta Army.

zh.headline: LeonLollipop首個個人展「Gloomie Museum托腮貓藝術館」於海港城展至10月25日
zh.dek: 展覽包括藝術家第100幅Gloomie肖像「Gloomie Lisa」蒙娜麗莎貓，以及兵馬俑造型貓士兵雕塑。

en.headline: OASES to announce next batch of 10 to 20 strategic enterprises on Thursday
en.dek: Director-general Peter Yan said the intake would be split evenly between mainland and overseas firms, including top pharmaceutical companies, with many valued above HK$100 billion.

zh.headline: 引進辦周四公布新一批十多至二十間重點企業
zh.dek: 主任任景信指新一批內地與海外企業各佔約一半，包括頂尖藥廠，不少市值逾千億元。

en.headline: Man found hanged in Sham Shui Po estate room dies at hospital
en.dek: Police said a 33-year-old man was discovered by family at Fu Cheong Estate around 6:10am and was pronounced dead after being taken to Caritas Medical Centre.

zh.headline: 深水埗富昌邨33歲男子被發現上吊 送院後不治
zh.dek: 警方指今早約6時10分，家人在富盈樓發現事主，解下後報案，送明愛醫院後證實死亡，現場沒有遺書。

en.headline: Government holds Chung Yeung ceremony at City Hall to honour wartime defenders
en.dek: Officials gathered at the Memorial Garden on Sunday morning for the annual rite commemorating those who died defending Hong Kong from 1941 to 1945.

zh.headline: 特區政府重陽節於大會堂舉行儀式悼念保衞香港捐軀人士
zh.dek: 官員及各界代表今早在大會堂紀念花園出席一年一度官方儀式，悼念1941至1945年間為保衞香港捐軀的人士。

en.headline: Observatory issues yellow fire danger warning on Chung Yeung morning
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the yellow signal at 8:15am as fire risk remains high amid dry conditions and expected hill visits.

zh.headline: 天文台重陽節早上發出黃色火災危險警告
zh.dek: 天文台於上午8時15分發出黃色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性頗高，市民及登山人士應提高警覺。

en.headline: EMSD finds 78 private buildings with missing lift door frames by Tai Zoom
en.dek: Inspections as of Saturday afternoon identified the additional cases beyond two public estates; the contractor will pay for all remedial work under supervision.

zh.headline: 機電署確認臺日升降機78幢私樓缺門框組件
zh.dek: 截至周六下午巡查，除兩個租置屋邨外共78幢私人樓宇未裝耐火門框，補裝費用由承辦商承擔，署方已動員商會協助加快工程。

en.headline: Passers-by report wild monkey foaming at mouth in Sham Shui Po
en.dek: Two people saw the animal near an oil station on Tai Po Road around 1am and called police and the SPCA; staff arrived after it had climbed a tree and left.

zh.headline: 深水埔野猴口吐白泡 途人報案愛協到場時已爬樹離開
zh.dek: 凌晨約一時，兩名途人在大埔道338號油站對開發現野猴口吐白泡，報案及通知愛協，人員抵達時猴子已爬樹離去。

en.headline: Observatory forecasts very hot weather on Wednesday, possibly record late date
en.dek: Under the influence of a strong El Niño and a strengthening anticyclone, the maximum temperature on 21 October could reach 33 degrees or above at the Observatory.

zh.headline: 天文台料下周三日間酷熱 或破年內最遲酷熱紀錄
zh.dek: 受超強厄爾尼諾及高空反氣旋影響，風勢微弱，若周三最高氣溫達33度或以上將刷新最遲酷熱日子紀錄。

en.headline: Hong Kong China International Tattoo Exhibition runs through Sunday at SoHo House
en.dek: More than 60 local and international artists are showing work at the three-day event in Sheung Wan, which includes an AI try-on system and a competition on the final day.

zh.headline: 香港中國國際紋身展2026於上環SoHo House舉行至周日
zh.dek: 超過60位本地及國際紋身師參展，設AI試紋身系統，周日有比賽，門票由200元起。

en.headline: Saltwater pipe bursts in Tin Shui Wai, spraying two storeys high
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department said flushing water to Tin Yuet Estate and part of Tin Chung Court was suspended and expected to resume at 7.30am on Sunday.

zh.headline: 天水圍爆鹹水管水柱噴兩層樓高 天悅邨及天頌苑停沖廁水
zh.dek: 水務署指涉事為直徑150毫米鹹水供水管，天悅邨及部分天頌苑沖廁水暫停，預計周日早上7時半恢復。

en.headline: Restaurant manager arrested after staging Amoy Plaza cash snatch report
en.dek: Police said a 22-year-old woman handed about HK$11,000 in company takings to a friend in a stairwell before reporting a robbery.

zh.headline: 淘大商場梯間「搶劫」原來是預先安排 食肆經理被捕
zh.dek: 警方指22歲女子與友人約定後交出約一萬一千元公司現金，再報案指被搶走，閉路電視顯示過程不符。

en.headline: Mark Six first prize rolls over after no winner in 111th draw
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club said the winning numbers were 3, 13, 27, 29, 30 and 40, with special number 9, and the jackpot will carry forward.

zh.headline: 六合彩第111期頭獎無人中 基金滾存至下期
zh.dek: 馬會公布中獎號碼為3、13、27、29、30及40，特別號碼9，下期頭獎估計約一千九百萬元。

en.headline: Police arrest two men linked to Sun Yee On after Granville Road brawl
en.dek: Officers recovered a chopper and rattan cane after a Friday evening fight in Tsim Sha Tsui that left one man injured.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀加連威老道打鬥 警方拘捕兩名新義安相關男子
zh.dek: 周五傍晚十多名男女在街頭混戰，一名男子受傷，警方在現場檢獲開山刀及藤條。

en.headline: EMSD orders all lift contractors to review 10 years of landing door works
en.dek: Contractors must confirm fire-resisting performance of landing doors and frames fitted between October 2017 and October 2026 and file declarations by 15 November.

zh.headline: 機電署要求全港升降機承辦商審視十年來層站門抗火效能
zh.dek: 承辦商須於11月15日前交回聲明書，確認2017年10月至2026年10月期間更換或增設的層站門及門框符合耐火規格。

en.headline: Fire Services Department steps up inspections ahead of APEC finance meeting
en.dek: Special patrols and enforcement will cover the Convention and Exhibition Centre, MTR stations, chemical suppliers and petrol stations before the 20-21 October gathering.

zh.headline: 消防處為APEC財長會議加強巡查及執法
zh.dek: 特別安排涵蓋會議展覽中心、港鐵站、化工供應商及油站等，確保10月20至21日會議順利舉行。

en.headline: Legislative Council uses AI for first time to analyse five-year plan debate
en.dek: President Starry Lee said the tool processed about 450,000 words of remarks from 88 lawmakers, with livelihood protection taking nearly 30 per cent of coverage.

zh.headline: 立法會首次以人工智能分析五年規劃及施政報告辯論發言
zh.dek: 李慧琼指秘書處分析約45萬字逐字紀錄，完善民生保障環節佔整體篇幅近三成，人才及北部都會區最受關注。

en.headline: Police call repeat iPhone Duo credit-card reports extremely regrettable
en.dek: More than 110 reports involving about HK$4.6 million have been logged; officers say Apple has still not enabled 3D Secure despite earlier advice.

zh.headline: 警方稱iPhone Duo信用卡舉報再現極度遺憾 批蘋果未啟用3DS
zh.dek: 網絡安全及科技罪案調查科高級督察盧震綱指接獲逾110宗報案、涉款約460萬元，最大一宗近23萬元，暫未有人被捕。

en.headline: Law says she is confident Hong Kong will reach 53.8 million visitors this year
en.dek: The culture, sports and tourism secretary cited double-digit growth in the first nine months and strong Golden Week arrivals, despite fewer short-haul visitors from higher fuel prices.

zh.headline: 羅淑佩稱有信心全年訪港旅客達5380萬人次
zh.dek: 文化體育及旅遊局局長指首九個月錄得約4070萬人次、按年雙位數增長，國慶黃金周內地客超預期，惟短途市場受燃油價格影響。

en.headline: Hongkong Land opens 15-day Halloween carnival with installations in Central
en.dek: Four large light installations including a giant eyeball appear at Statue Square Garden from today until 31 October; most areas are free to enter.

zh.headline: 置地公司中環萬聖節狂歡祭今日啟動 皇后像廣場設四大裝置
zh.dek: 活動由今日至31日一連15天舉行，巨型眼球等裝置於下午四時起亮燈，大部分區域免費開放。

en.headline: Ka Ying Rising finishes second in The Everest, ending 21-race winning streak
en.dek: The Hong Kong-trained sprinter, ridden by Zac Purton, was beaten by a neck by I Wish I Win at Randwick on Saturday.

zh.headline: 「嘉應高昇」澳洲珠穆朗瑪峰錦標屈居第二 連勝紀錄告終
zh.dek: 由潘頓策騎、大衛希斯訓練的短途馬王自第十一檔出發，以一頸位之差不敵「動心」，跨季21連勝終止。

en.headline: Police seize 32 kg of ketamine worth over HK$12 million in Sha Tin public housing raid
en.dek: Officers arrested a 28-year-old man and two 15-year-old girls after finding the drugs packed with old clothes; the three are due in court on Monday.

zh.headline: 警方沙田公屋檢獲約32公斤氯胺酮 拘28歲男及兩名15歲少女
zh.dek: 毒品調查科周五下午行動中起出市值逾1200萬元懷疑氯胺酮，三人將於周一在屯門裁判法院提堂。

en.headline: Police arrest 75-year-old man over hammer damage and faeces at Tsui Ping North Estate
en.dek: A resident was detained after staff found five smashed windows and faeces on the door of a shared kitchen in Tsui Mei House this morning.

zh.headline: 觀塘翠屏北邨七旬翁被捕 涉鐵錘砸共用廚房五窗兼大門塗糞
zh.dek: 今早約八時屋邨職員發現翠楣樓共用廚房五道玻璃窗被毀及大門有糞便污漬，警方拘捕75歲陳姓男子並檢獲鐵錘。

en.headline: Woman robbed of HK$11,000 cash in Amoy Plaza stairwell in Ngau Tau Kok
en.dek: A 22-year-old woman was pushed from behind and had cash snatched late on Friday night while heading to an ATM; police are seeking a man in a grey sweatshirt.

zh.headline: 牛頭角淘大商場梯間女子被搶走約一萬一千元現金
zh.dek: 二十二歲女子周五晚約十一時在商場梯間被男從後推撞並搶走現金，警方正追緝穿灰色長袖衛衣男子。

en.headline: Police receive over 100 reports of credit card charges linked to iPhone Duo pre-orders
en.dek: Complaints of duplicate or unauthorised transactions began after Apple opened online pre-orders at 8pm on Friday, with sums running into the millions of dollars.

zh.headline: 警方接獲逾百宗iPhone Duo預購信用卡扣款舉報
zh.dek: 蘋果周五晚八時開放摺疊式手機預購後，市民紛紛反映重複或未經授權交易，涉及金額達數百萬元。

en.headline: Husband arrested after wife reports theft of Rolex and handbags worth HK$450,000 in Yau…
en.dek: A 40-year-old man was detained after his 34-year-old wife reported that a Rolex watch and three designer bags had gone missing from their Ocean One flat on Saturday morning.

zh.headline: 油塘丈夫被拘 妻報稱家中勞力士及手袋失竊涉約四十五萬元
zh.dek: 三十四歲女子今早報稱油塘Ocean One單位內勞力士手錶及三個名牌手袋失竊，警方拘捕其四十歲丈夫。

en.headline: Hong Kong Ballet premieres Dunhuang: In Search of Light at Cultural Centre
en.dek: The new work, inspired by Mogao Caves and Hermann Hesse’s Siddhartha, runs until Sunday with performances at 2:30pm and 7:30pm today.

zh.headline: 香港芭蕾舞團世界首演《敦煌：溯光行》於文化中心上演
zh.dek: 由胡頌威及麥靜雯編舞，靈感來自敦煌壁畫及赫塞《流浪者之歌》，今明兩日下午及晚上仍有演出。

en.headline: Police arrest 53 in Double Hammer operation targeting triad drug and vice activities
en.dek: Officers seized about 3.6 kg of cannabis products worth nearly HK$1 million and raided a public-housing packaging centre and a Wan Chai private club.

zh.headline: 警方「雙錘」行動打擊三合會黃賭毒 拘捕53人檢獲3600克大麻
zh.dek: 港島總區聯同入境處行動，包括柴灣公屋毒品包裝中心及灣仔私人會所，檢獲市值約100萬元毒品。

en.headline: Helicopter lifts woman after she vomits blood while hiking near Sai Kung Danjiawan
en.dek: A middle-aged woman in a group of 16 was airlifted conscious to Eastern Hospital after sudden cramps and vomiting blood on Saturday morning.

zh.headline: 西貢蛋家灣中年婦行山突吐血抽筋 直升機救起送東區醫院
zh.dek: 16名女子今早由黃石碼頭出發，其中一名中年婦近蛋家灣時不適，清醒由政府飛行服務隊直升機送院。

en.headline: Hospital Authority to open 15 family medicine clinics on Chung Yeung holiday Monday
en.dek: Services will run from 9am to 1pm and 2pm to 5pm on 19 October; patients can book by phone, eHealth or HA Go.

zh.headline: 醫管局公布重陽節翌日15間家庭醫學診所提供門診服務
zh.dek: 十月十九日公眾假期上午九時至一時及下午二時至五時開放，市民可經電話、醫健通或HA Go預約。

en.headline: Fire on moored barge at Ngong Shuen Chau extinguished after about 90 minutes
en.dek: Firefighters put out a blaze on a pontoon near Ang Yan Road by 11:18am on Saturday; 15 people were evacuated and no injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 昂船洲貲船起火約九十分鐘後救熄 十五人疏散無人傷
zh.dek: 消防今早近十時接報昂船洲昂運路對開貲船火警，十一時十八分大致救熄，呼籲受煙霧影響市民留室內關窗。

en.headline: Six people assault woman with hammers and steal cash and phone in To Kwa Wan
en.dek: A 43-year-old woman was injured in the hands and feet after being attacked at her flat on Wing Yiu Street this morning; police are hunting the suspects who knew her.

zh.headline: 土瓜灣唐樓女子遭六人持錘施襲 掠走三千元及手機
zh.dek: 今早約七時永耀街一單位女住戶被認識人士持錘毆打，手腳受傷送伊利沙伯醫院，警方列襲擊及盜竊追查。

en.headline: Observatory issues yellow fire danger warning as risk remains high
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the yellow fire danger warning at 9:45am on Saturday, urging the public to prevent fires and hikers to stay vigilant.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色火災危險警告 指火險頗高
zh.dek: 天文台今日上午9時45分發出黃色火災危險警告，呼籲市民防止火災發生，遠足人士亦須提高警覺。

en.headline: Tang says 999 upgrades will add real-time video and AI prioritisation by 2028
en.dek: Callers could use WhatsApp or WeChat to send live images of incidents, with information shared instantly to the Fire Services Department.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強：999將增實時視像及人工智能分流 目標2028年啟用
zh.dek: 市民日後可用WhatsApp或微信拍攝現場，報案資訊即時傳送消防處，火警等優先處理。

en.headline: 11-year-old boy found unconscious at Fanling home later confirmed dead
en.dek: Police received a report from the boy's father at about 6am on Saturday; ambulance officers confirmed death at the scene and investigations continue.

zh.headline: 粉嶺欣翠花園11歲男童家中昏迷 當場證實不治
zh.dek: 今早約6時父親報案，救護員到場證實男童明顯死亡，警方正在調查死因。

en.headline: Security chief expects Huanggang port to exceed 100,000 daily crossings over Chung Yeung
en.dek: Daily traffic has averaged over 80,000 since the new port opened, with Friday topping 92,000; waiting times remain under 15 minutes.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強料重陽長假新皇崗口岸高峰日過關人次破10萬
zh.dek: 新口岸近日日均逾8萬人次，周五超過9.2萬，等候時間一般少於5分鐘，效率較舊口岸提升至少四倍。

en.headline: Police investigate oil attacks on two Yau Ma Tei restaurants within 38 minutes
en.dek: Red oil hit a Portland Street cha chaan teng and black oil a Bowring Street dim sum shop early Saturday; no arrests and no injuries reported.

zh.headline: 油麻地兩食肆38分鐘內遭淋油 警列刑事毀壞追查
zh.dek: 砵蘭街茶餐廳招牌染紅油，寶靈街點心店則被淋黑油，暫無人被捕，亦無人受傷。

en.headline: Transport bureau to review bus fare applications of up to 17.7 per cent carefully
en.dek: Citybus seeks the largest rise while KMB asks for 16 per cent; lawmakers at Friday's panel meeting criticised the scale and raised service issues.

zh.headline: 運物局稱審慎處理巴士加價申請 加幅介乎8.1%至17.7%
zh.dek: 城巴申請加價17.7%為最高，九巴申請16%，立法會交通事務委員會周五討論時議員批評加幅過高。

en.headline: Chief Executive accepts recommendation to appoint New Zealand judge to top court
en.dek: Sir Terence Arnold would become the sixth non-permanent judge from other common law jurisdictions, subject to Legislative Council endorsement.

zh.headline: 行政長官接納推薦委任新西蘭法官為終審法院海外非常任法官
zh.dek: 區諾德爵士將成為第六名來自其他普通法司法管轄區的非常任法官，仍待立法會通過。

en.headline: HKEX targets T+1 settlement for cash market in second half of 2028
en.dek: The exchange operator received broad support in consultation and will adopt a three-layer implementation framework, with Southbound Stock Connect following the same cycle.

zh.headline: 港交所目標2028年下半年實施港股現貨T+1結算周期
zh.dek: 諮詢獲市場廣泛支持，將採三層實施方案，港股通同步過渡。

en.headline: Hong Kong Wine and Dine Festival returns to harbourfront from 29 October
en.dek: The four-day event organised by the Tourism Board will feature more than 340 booths at Central Harbourfront and Tamar Park, with later hours on Friday and Saturday.

zh.headline: 香港美酒佳餚巡禮10月29日起重返中環海濱
zh.dek: 旅發局主辦的四日盛事設逾340個攤位於中環海濱活動空間及添馬公園舉行，周五六延長至凌晨1時。

en.headline: Citybus extends B14 to all-day service on trial from Saturday
en.dek: The Kai Tak to Huanggang Port express route will run throughout the day until 1 November, with northbound services from 8am to 9pm.

zh.headline: 城巴B14周六起試辦全日服務往返啟德及皇崗口岸
zh.dek: 北上班次由上午八時至晚上九時，南下班次至晚上十一時，試辦期至十一月一日，最快約四十分鐘可達口岸。

en.headline: Customs seize 8.8 kg of cannabis buds at airport in two passenger cases
en.dek: Two mainland travellers were arrested over suspected cannabis found in carry-on baggage, with cases listed for West Kowloon court on Saturday.

zh.headline: 海關機場連破兩宗販毒案 檢約8.8公斤大麻花拘兩內地客
zh.dek: 兩名內地旅客手提行李藏懷疑大麻花被捕，案件周六在西九龍裁判法院提堂，估計總市值約183萬元。

en.headline: Buildings Department orders checks on eight more houses at One Stanley
en.dek: The developer updated its sales brochure after the department required investigations of additional detached houses following earlier rebar irregularities.

zh.headline: 屋宇署要求One Stanley再查八座獨立屋鋼筋問題
zh.dek: 發展商更新售樓書，披露屋宇署於十月二日要求就另外八座洋房及公用地方進行調查，一個月內提交報告。

en.headline: Government to roll out four new signature tourism projects from fourth quarter
en.dek: The batch includes industrial brand tours at bus depots and MTR exhibits, a miniature city display at the Peak, temple digitalisation and Yuen Long seasonal events.

zh.headline: 政府第四季起推四項新特色旅遊項目涵蓋工業品牌及廟宇文化
zh.dek: 項目包括九巴車廠及港鐵展覽參觀、山頂微型城市展、廟宇數碼化，以及元朗季節性地區活動。

en.headline: Customs seize HK$50 million in counterfeit hard disks, arrest six in Tuen Mun
en.dek: Officers raided five industrial units and found about 6,800 suspected counterfeit disks plus 20,000 second-hand units awaiting processing.

zh.headline: 海關屯門搞冒牌硬碟工場拘6人 檢值約5000萬貨
zh.dek: 關員搜查五個工廈單位，檢獲約6800個懷疑冒牌硬碟及2萬個待加工二手硬碟。

en.headline: Tourism Board launches first Halloween Month with citywide cosplay parties
en.dek: Street celebrations begin on Saturday in Central, Lan Kwai Fong, Mong Kok, Tsim Sha Tsui East and Kai Tak, with free admission at several venues.

zh.headline: 旅發局首辦「香港萬聖月」全城Cosplay街頭派對今日啟動
zh.dek: 中環、蘭桂坊、旺角、尖東及啟德多區周六起舉行街頭慶祝活動，多個場地免費入場。

en.headline: Police arrest three over missing fire door frames in public estate lift works
en.dek: A company director and two registered engineers were detained on fraud suspicions after EMSD found 48 lifts at two estates lacked required components.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕三人涉公屋升降機工程欠裝耐火門框
zh.dek: 機電署發現兩屋苑48部升降機未裝所需門框組件，一名董事及兩名註冊工程師因涉嫌欺詐被扣留。

en.headline: Fire Services Department deploys AI-assisted drones and extra patrols for Chung Yeung…
en.dek: More than 250 frontline staff will form 12 patrol teams at high-risk sites in the New Territories, with drones sending live images for real-time smoke detection.

zh.headline: 消防處重陽節前動員逾二百五十人巡邏 引入AI無人機協助偵測山火
zh.dek: 超過250名前線人員組成12支巡邏隊進駐新界高風險地點，無人機影像實時傳送AI平台識別煙霧。

en.headline: Five Guangdong yachts make first arrival under new southbound travel scheme
en.dek: The vessels from Shenzhen, Nansha and Zhuhai docked at Lantau Yacht Club on Friday after the scheme took effect, with a welcome ceremony attended by senior officials.

zh.headline: 五艘廣東遊艇在「粵艇南下」新計劃下首次抵港
zh.dek: 來自深圳、南沙及珠海的遊艇周五偽晚停泊大嶼山遊艇會，高層官員出席歡迎儀式。

en.headline: M+ opens Myths and Monsters exhibition exploring fantasy in Asian visual culture
en.dek: The special exhibition runs from 17 October 2026 to 4 April 2027 at the West Gallery, presenting more than 400 works spanning the nineteenth to twenty-first centuries.

zh.headline: M+「神話與怪獸」展覽周六開幕 探討亞洲視覺文化中的奇幻
zh.dek: 特別展覽由今天至2027年4月4日在西展廳舉行，展出逾400件橫跨十九至二十一世紀的作品。

en.headline: West Kowloon court imposes three-month hospital order on woman convicted of displaying…
en.dek: The 62-year-old was found guilty of knowingly displaying publications with seditious intent after materials including a colonial-era flag were found outside her Tin Shui Wai flat.

zh.headline: 西九龍法庭裁定六旬婦展示煲動刊物罪成 判三個月住院令
zh.dek: 62歲女子被指在天水圍天頌苑單位外張貼港英期旗幟及標語，被裁定明知而展示具煲動意圖的刊物罪成。

en.headline: Housing Bureau says 93.2 per cent of Wang Fuk Court owners signed sale agreements…
en.dek: A total of 1,850 owners across the eight blocks completed the Agreement for Sale and Purchase after the October 15 deadline, with remaining cases to be handled individually.

zh.headline: 房屋局指王福苑九成三業主在截止前簽署買賣合約
zh.dek: 八座樓宇共有1,850名業主完成買賣合約，佔總數的百分之九十三點二，餘下個案將個別處理。

en.headline: Police arrest two men over Kowloon break-in spree worth HK$1.7 million
en.dek: A 54-year-old mainland man and a 34-year-old local man were detained over at least nine residential burglaries in Kowloon since July, with losses including cash, watches and jewellery.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕兩男涉九龍區連環爆竊 損失約170萬
zh.dek: 54歲內地男子及34歲本地男子被控涉及自七月以來至少九宗住宅爆竊，失物包括現金、手錶及珠寶。

en.headline: Science Museum opens Future Science Prize Exhibition until 18 November
en.dek: The ground-floor show highlights this year's three laureates and past Hong Kong winners through multimedia and interactive displays on topics including autophagy and mesoporous materials.

zh.headline: 科學館舉行2026未來科學大獎展覽至11月18日
zh.dek: 地下展覽廳以「生活中的科學」為題，介紹本年度三位得主及歷年香港獲獎者，設多媒體互動展品。

en.headline: Observatory forecasts fine and dry weather for Chung Yeung weekend
en.dek: Rain patches are expected on Saturday and Sunday morning before conditions turn mainly fine and dry from later on the Chung Yeung Festival through early next week.

zh.headline: 天文台預測重陽節周末轉晴乾燥
zh.dek: 周六及周日早上有一兩陣雨，重陽節稍後至下周初大致天晴及乾燥，中期日間炎熱。

en.headline: HKEX targets second half of 2028 for T+1 settlement
en.dek: The exchange published consultation conclusions showing broad support for shortening the cash-market cycle from T+2, while delaying the earlier proposed 2027 timeline after industry feedback.

zh.headline: 港交所目標2028年下半年過渡至T+1結算
zh.dek: 諮詢總結顯示市場廣泛支持將現貨市場結算周期由T+2縮短，但因業界要求更多準備時間，較早前提議的2027年時間表已推遲。

en.headline: Buildings Department orders investigation of eight more One Stanley houses
en.dek: The developer updated its sales brochure on Friday to disclose a 2 October letter requiring detailed checks and a report within one month on the original villa plus eight others and common areas.

zh.headline: 屋宇署要求One Stanley發展商調查額外八座洋房
zh.dek: 發展商周五更新售樓書，披露本月2日接獲署方函件，須就涉事洋房及另外八座洋房連公用地方在一個月內提交詳細調查報告。

en.headline: Sham Shui Po woman dies after melioidosis infection
en.dek: The 74-year-old with underlying illnesses was admitted with pneumonia and tested positive for the bacterium; the Centre for Health Protection says the case appears sporadic.

zh.headline: 深水埗74歲女子感染類鼻疽後離世
zh.dek: 患者有長期病患，因肺炎入院後樣本對類鼻疽伯克氏菌呈陽性，防護中心指個案屬散發，正調查感染源頭。

en.headline: Police arrest man over pouring liquid on women at Tsim Sha Tsui MTR
en.dek: A 26-year-old man faces three indecent assault charges and one wounding charge after incidents in January and early October at the station and a nearby mall.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀港鐵站淋液體案 警方拘捕26歲男子
zh.dek: 男子涉嫌在一月及十月初於港鐵尖沙咀站及附近商場向女性淋潑不明液體，將被控三項猥褻侵犯及一項傷人。

en.headline: Chief Executive accepts recommendation to appoint former New Zealand judge as CFA…
en.dek: The appointment of the retired New Zealand Supreme Court permanent judge will take effect after Legislative Council approval, raising the number of overseas non-permanent judges to six.

zh.headline: 行政長官接納推薦 任命新西蘭前最高法院常任法官為終院非常任法官
zh.dek: 區諾德獲任命後，其他普通法適用地區非常任法官將增至六名，須立法會同意後生效。

en.headline: Transport Department sets special arrangements at Huanggang control point for Chung Yeung
en.dek: Bus and minibus frequencies will be increased from Saturday as cross-boundary flows rise, with Monday afternoon to evening expected to be the peak return period.

zh.headline: 運輸署皇崗口岸重陽節實施特別交通安排 料下周一下午至傍晚為回港高峰
zh.dek: 周六起加密專營巴士及小巴班次，呼籲市民提早計劃行程，按需要選擇其他口岸過關。

en.headline: Centre for Health Protection records two imported chikungunya and one dengue case
en.dek: The two chikungunya patients had visited the mainland during the incubation period; the dengue case was linked to travel in Cambodia. Both diseases remain mostly imported this year.

zh.headline: 衛生防護中心錄得兩宗輸入性基孔肯雅熱及一宗登革熱個案
zh.dek: 兩名基孔肯雅熱患者潛伏期內曾到內地，登革熱個案與柬埔寨行程有關，今年個案大多為外地傳入。

en.headline: Housing Bureau opens applications for all 13 light public housing projects
en.dek: With the final two school-conversion sites due in the first quarter next year, the full portfolio of about 30,000 units will be complete by end-March, ahead of the original five-year target.

zh.headline: 房屋局宣布簡約公屋13個項目全部開放接受申請
zh.dek: 最後兩個校舍改建項目明年首季落成，約3萬個單位將於明年三月底前全部完成，提前達標。

en.headline: Police arrest company director and two engineers over lift works deficiencies
en.dek: New Territories South Regional Crime Unit detained three men aged 63 to 82 after EMSD referred findings of missing fire-door frames at two estates.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕臺日電梯董事及兩名註冊工程師 涉升降機工程缺失
zh.dek: 新界南總區重案組拘捕三名63至82歲男子，機電署早前轉介兩屋邨耐火門框組件未裝便報完工的個案。
